Based on my search, here's what I found about watching MSNBC live streaming free online:

## Free Options to Watch MSNBC Live Online

### Official Free Trials (Legitimate Options)
The most reliable way to watch MSNBC for free is through **free trials** from legitimate streaming services:

| Service | Free Trial | Regular Price | Notes |
|---------|-----------|---------------|-------|
| **fuboTV** | 7 days | ~$79.99-$94.99/month | Includes 90+ channels |
| **YouTube TV** | 7-14 days | ~$72.99-$82.99/month | 100+ channels, unlimited DVR |
| **Hulu + Live TV** | 3-7 days | ~$76.99/month | Includes Disney+ and ESPN+ |
| **Sling TV (Blue)** | Occasional promotions | Starting at ~$40-51/month | MSNBC included in Sling Blue |
| **DIRECTV STREAM** | 5 days | Starting at ~$69.99/month | 75+ channels |

**Important**: You must cancel before the trial ends to avoid charges.

### Free Clips and Limited Content
- **MSNBC.com** - Offers free clips and segments from shows
- **YouTube (MSNBC channel)** - Free clips and some full segments
- **Peacock Free tier** - Select MSNBC content available, but **NOT the live channel**
- **MSNBC social media** (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram) - Free updates and clips

### Third-Party Free Streaming Sites
Several websites claim to offer free MSNBC live streams:
- **usnewson.com/watch/msnbc-live**
- **livenewsnow.com/american/msnbc-live-stream.html**
- **livenewstime.com/msnbc-live/**
- **newslive.com/american/msnbc-news-live.html**
- **ufreetv.com/msnbc.html**

**⚠️ Caution**: These unofficial streaming sites may have questionable legality, reliability, and security risks. They often contain excessive ads and may not provide consistent, high-quality streams.

### MSNBC App
The MSNBC app offers **live streaming for authenticated cable/satellite subscribers only**. Non-subscribers can access some clips for free.

## Important Note About "MS NOW"
MSNBC rebranded to **"MS NOW"** (My Source for News, Opinion, and the World) in 2025 as part of its separation from NBCUniversal into a new entity called Versant. The content and programming remain largely the same.

## Summary
There is **no completely free, legal, unlimited way to watch MSNBC live** without some form of subscription or trial. Your best options are:
1. Sign up for a free trial and cancel before it ends
2. Use free clips on official platforms
3. Consider budget options like Sling Blue (cheapest regular option)
